thread:
maria: Hey team — I addressed the requested proto contract changes in https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1234. I split the proto change into a small compatibility shim, added a migration for downstream config, and added unit + integration tests. PTAL when you get a minute.

devin: thanks! quick q — can you give a short recap of what the shim does? worried about consumers parsing unknown fields.

maria: Shim maps old field "priority" -> "priority_v2" and preserves unknown fields in an "extra" map. Short snippet I added to the PR: 
```go
// proto shim example
if msg.GetPriority() != nil { msg.PriorityV2 = mapOld(msg.Priority) }
```
Should be safe; added tests that deserialize both old and new wire formats.

kai: PTAL for contract risk and API docs. Also, how is migration applied in Dedicated? any db lock concerns?

maria: No DB lock — migration runs as an idempotent background job. For Dedicated customers we gate it with the feature flag REDWOOD_PROTO_MIGRATE. Rollback plan is: flip the flag + revert canary. I added an ops playbook to the PR description.

ci-bot: build status — all checks passed :white_check_mark: (unit, integration, docs).

sam: LGTM from me on code + tests. can you add a one-liner to the changelog about rollback procedure?

maria: done — added changelog entry and a short rollback/monitoring checklist in the PR. Also requesting a canary slot: would like to merge before EOD Wed if reviewers are good. Prefer to keep commits (no squash) to preserve the shim history.

devin: i can approve after a tiny nit — can you move the shim docs into /docs/protos.md so infra and SRE can find it? then PTAL.

maria: moved docs to /docs/protos.md, pushed fix. pinging @kai and @devin for final approval, thanks :pray:.

kai: giving final approve, leaving a follow-up to monitor prefix cache hit-rate during rollout. :thumbsup:

devin: approve from me too. :shipit:

maria: thanks all — I'll schedule the canary slot with infra, enable the flag at start-of-canary, and watch the playbook metrics. closing thread.
